title: Grateful Dead Live at Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center on 1986-12-27
source: 2 Source matrix mix of shnid 81267(aud) and shnid 99050(sbd) with patches used from shnid 88965(aud)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording with very good sound and a strong Jerry Garcia performance
ai_review.review: The mix is praised as very good, delivering clear audio that captures the band well. Reviewers note that despite rumors about his playing, Jerry Garcia sounds darn good on this show.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it is highly positive for both sound quality and Jerry's guitar work, suggesting a strong overall experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as "very good," indicating clear and well‑balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on setlist or flow were provided.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sounds darn good; reviewer highlights strong guitar performance.
